text: Handling deadlines can be stressful, but good habits make it easier. First, manage your time carefully by planning tasks in a calendar and starting early. Second, prioritise your work: focus on the most important tasks first and leave less urgent ones for later. Third, manage the scope of your project. If you try to do too much, you may miss the deadline, so decide what is really necessary. Finally, communicate with your team or manager. If you are falling behind, tell them early so they can help. With these simple steps, you can meet deadlines more calmly and successfully.
